sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: A small, very compact agave native to Mexico. Horticultural references give about 15–35 cm in height and 20–55 cm across. Its stiff, dark leaves have smooth margins and distinctive white markings. The flower stalk reaches about 3–5 m; cream flowers may be tinged purple or red. A rosette flowers once and then dies.

sections.title: Uses and safety
sections.text: Its marginal spines are a contact hazard. Food use was not established in the sources consulted.
